private-key-hex.description: PDS private key as hex string

public-hostname.description: Public hostname for requestCrawl (may differ from bind hostname)

crawlers.description: Comma-separated relay URLs to notify on writes

plc-directory-url.description: PLC directory base URL; when set, accounts are did:plc registered here instead of did:key

tls-cert-file.description: PEM certificate to serve TLS with; requires tls-key-file

tls-key-file.description: PEM private key to serve TLS with; requires tls-cert-file

subscribe-repos-format.description: Firehose wire format: drisl (default) for binary frames, json for the string frames atproto-relay reads

kv-path.description: Deno KV store path; the PDS keeps its repos, service key, accounts, user signing keys and OAuth tokens there, so a restart keeps every account and session; unset keeps repos only, at Deno's default location under DENO_DIR

write-limit-file.description: Path of a JSON file {points, windowSec}; while the file exists, repo writes are rate limited like a hosted PDS (create 3, update 2, delete 1 points) with ratelimit headers and 429 plus retry-after; delete the file to switch the limit off

port-file.description: File the bound TCP port is written to once listening (used with port 0)

listeners-file.description: File every bound listener (tcp, unix, relay) is reported to as JSON once listening
